entities.name: Hüseyin Hilmi Pasha
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hüseyin Hilmi Pasha was an Ottoman statesman and imperial administrator. He was twice the Grand Vizier of the Ottoman Empire around the time of the Second Constitutional Era. He was also one-time president of the Turkish Red Crescent, the Turkish affiliate of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.
